name: easecraft-workspace
description: Accessible motion primitives and animated React components, powered by Anime.js.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter easecraft-tokens build && pnpm --filter easecraft build && turbo run dev
scripts.publint: publint packages/tokens && publint packages/react && publint packages/registry
scripts.release:check: pnpm build && pnpm publint && pnpm --filter easecraft-tokens pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter easecraft pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter easecraft-registry pack --dry-run
